rule.sl:
Kar je mogoče: **may**, **might**, **could** + osnovna oblika, brez to in brez -s: **It might rain.** (Morda bo deževalo.) **Jack may be on the fell.** **She could be at the inn.** Zanikano **might not**, **may not** (morda ne): **He might not come.** **couldn't** tu pomeni *nemogoče*.

Kar sklepaš: **must** (gotovo je tako), **can't** (gotovo ni tako): **That must be Jack: it's his dog.** (To je gotovo Jack: to je njegov pes.) **It can't be Jack: he's in Keswick.** (To ne more biti Jack: v Keswicku je.) V Ameriki, na Škotskem, Irskem in severu Anglije rečejo tudi **must not**, **mustn't** (*It must not be Jack*), pisno v Britaniji velja can't.

**can** je to, kar se včasih zgodi: **It can rain here for days.** Za danes popoldne **might**.

Za to, kar se dogaja zdaj: **He must be sleeping.** **She might be working.**

**probably** (verjetno) stoji za will in pred won't: **He'll probably come.** **He probably won't come.** **perhaps** in **maybe** (morda) stojita spredaj: **Maybe he's ill.**
rule.de:
Was möglich ist: **may**, **might**, **could** + Grundform, ohne to und ohne -s: **It might rain.** (Es könnte regnen.) **Jack may be on the fell.** **She could be at the inn.** Verneint **might not**, **may not** (vielleicht nicht): **He might not come.** **couldn't** heißt hier *unmöglich*.

Was du schließt: **must** (sicher ja), **can't** (sicher nein): **That must be Jack: it's his dog.** (Das muss Jack sein: Das ist sein Hund.) **It can't be Jack: he's in Keswick.** (Das kann nicht Jack sein: Er ist in Keswick.) *muss nicht* ist **might not**. In Amerika, Schottland, Irland und Nordengland sagt man auch **must not**, **mustn't** (*It must not be Jack*), geschrieben gilt in Britannien can't.

**can** ist, was manchmal geschieht: **It can rain here for days.** Für heute Nachmittag **might**.

Für das, was gerade geschieht: **He must be sleeping.** **She might be working.**

**probably** (wahrscheinlich) steht nach will und vor won't: **He'll probably come.** **He probably won't come.** **perhaps** und **maybe** (vielleicht) stehen vorn: **Maybe he's ill.**
rule.it:
Ciò che è possibile: **may**, **might**, **could** + la forma base, senza to e senza -s: **It might rain.** (Potrebbe piovere.) **Jack may be on the fell.** **She could be at the inn.** Al negativo **might not**, **may not** (forse no): **He might not come.** **couldn't** qui vuol dire *impossibile*.

Ciò che deduci: **must** (di sicuro sì), **can't** (di sicuro no): **That must be Jack: it's his dog.** (Dev'essere Jack: è il suo cane.) **It can't be Jack: he's in Keswick.** (Non può essere Jack: è a Keswick.) In America, in Scozia, in Irlanda e nel nord dell'Inghilterra si dice anche **must not**, **mustn't** (*It must not be Jack*), per iscritto in Gran Bretagna vale can't.

**can** è ciò che a volte succede: **It can rain here for days.** Per oggi pomeriggio **might**.

Per ciò che succede ora: **He must be sleeping.** **She might be working.**

**probably** (probabilmente) va dopo will e prima di won't: **He'll probably come.** **He probably won't come.** **perhaps** e **maybe** (forse) vanno all'inizio: **Maybe he's ill.**
rule.en:
What is possible: **may**, **might**, **could** + the base form, with no to and no -s: **It might rain.** **Jack may be on the fell.** **She could be at the inn.** With not: **might not**, **may not** (perhaps not): **He might not come.** **couldn't** here means *impossible*.

What you work out: **must** (I'm sure it is), **can't** (I'm sure it isn't): **That must be Jack: it's his dog.** **It can't be Jack: he's in Keswick.** In America, Scotland, Ireland and the North people also say **must not**, **mustn't** (*It must not be Jack*); British writing wants can't.

**can** is what sometimes happens: **It can rain here for days.** For this afternoon, **might**.

For what is going on now: **He must be sleeping.** **She might be working.**

**probably** goes after will and before won't: **He'll probably come.** **He probably won't come.** **perhaps** and **maybe** stand first: **Maybe he's ill.**

rule.sl: Morda: **might**, **may**, **could**: **It might rain.** Morda ne: **might not**, **may not**. Gotovo je tako: **must**: **That must be Jack.** Gotovo ni tako: **can't**: **It can't be Jack.** Verjetno: **He'll probably come.** **He probably won't come.**
rule.de: Vielleicht: **might**, **may**, **could**: **It might rain.** Vielleicht nicht: **might not**, **may not**. Sicher ja: **must**: **That must be Jack.** Sicher nein: **can't**: **It can't be Jack.** Wahrscheinlich: **He'll probably come.** **He probably won't come.**
rule.it: Forse: **might**, **may**, **could**: **It might rain.** Forse no: **might not**, **may not**. Di sicuro sì: **must**: **That must be Jack.** Di sicuro no: **can't**: **It can't be Jack.** Probabilmente: **He'll probably come.** **He probably won't come.**
rule.en: Perhaps: **might**, **may**, **could**: **It might rain.** Perhaps not: **might not**, **may not**. Sure it is: **must**: **That must be Jack.** Sure it isn't: **can't**: **It can't be Jack.** Likely: **He'll probably come.** **He probably won't come.**

tip.sl: 💡 Slovensko *ne more biti* je **can't be**; *morda ne* je **might not**.
tip.de: 💡 *Das muss nicht Jack sein* ist **It might not be Jack**; *das kann nicht sein* ist **It can't be**.
tip.it: 💡 *Può piovere* per oggi è **It might rain**; *non può essere* è **It can't be**.
tip.en: 💡 The opposite of **must be** is **can't be**; *perhaps not* is **might not**.
